trust_decision.summary: Whether a one-shot symmetric cipher call that is split into ALG_MAX_PAGES-sized chunks re-sends the caller's IV (ALG_SET_IV) on every chunk; decided in _kcapi_cipher_crypt_chunk, which at the pinned commit already clears handle->cipher.iv after the first chunk so later chunks continue from the kernel's chained IV.

landing_point.why: The summary names one-shot symmetric cipher chunking; _kcapi_cipher_crypt_chunk is the only chunking loop, reached from kcapi_cipher_encrypt/decrypt (lib/kcapi-sym.c:60, lib/kcapi-sym.c:141).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: unknown: the listed fix changes no source logic, so there is no published-scope site to dismiss. The only nearby IV-reuse-shaped route, AIO per-iovec IV re-send, is documented as intended ('separate invocations of the given cipher', lib/kcapi.h:201-202).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: kcapi_cipher_*_aio sends the same caller IV with each iovec because each iovec is documented as its own independent cipher operation. An over-broad fix that also clears or chains the IV there would change documented AIO semantics.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second chunking loop (for example a vmsplice-path or AEAD one-shot chunker) that forgets to drop handle->cipher.iv between chunks.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: _kcapi_cipher_crypt is shared by the sym, AEAD, asym and KPP one-shots (lib/kcapi-aead.c:248, lib/kcapi-asym.c:56). A maintainer adding chunking for another cipher type could copy the loop without the IV-clear. However, this would be a planted WHERE-type copy, which only counts as an extra.

O10_build.project_tests: test/kcapi-enc-test-large.c and test/kcapi-enc-test-large.sh (large-buffer encryption), test/test.sh; all need AF_ALG kernel sockets

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set handle->cipher.iv = NULL after every send in _kcapi_common_send_meta, which also breaks the stream and AIO paths that rely on the IV being sent.

out_of_scope_notes: The listed fix commit df40ea4 is 'bump copyright year' and changes only copyright headers (fix.diff:1-2). It contains no security change.

The pinned commit's own history includes 017adba 'Add safety measure to prevent IV reuse'. The IV-clear guard is already present at lib/kcapi-kernel-if.c:1391-1398, so the advisory's fix appears to be already applied at the pinned commit.
unverified: That 017adba is the real fix for CVE-2026-71225 is inferred only from the commit subject in the git log. Its diff was not read (no git commands were run).
O12 regression_tests_in_pinned_commit: the test files the diff touches (for example test/kcapi-enc-test-large.c) exist at the pinned commit, but the diff only changes their copyright lines.

O12 needs_gpu_kernel_gui: the behaviour needs kernel AF_ALG sockets (a kernel facility, usually built in, not an out-of-tree module). This is listed because hidden tests cannot run without kernel crypto support.
